# Cita

Cita converts auxiliary text into self-contained citation URLs.

For URL references:
- ?q=<url-encoded-text> stores plain text in the URL.
- ?algo=gzip&q=<base64url> stores UTF-8 text compressed with gzip.
- The citation page intentionally does not render the payload in its initial HTML response.
- A browser redirects to human/ and decodes the payload there.

For LLM clients:
- Prefer the MCP endpoint at /mcp when available.
- Call create_reference with the complete content.
- The tool automatically returns whichever self-contained form is shorter: plain URL encoding or gzip + Base64URL.
- No citation content is stored server-side by Cita.
- Cite the returned URL directly.
- Do not follow human/ unless you need to verify or inspect the generated content.
